fact: The National Bank of Ethiopia register lists licensed payment instrument issuers: Ethiotelecom/Telebirr (23 April 2021), Kacha (16 June 2022), Safaricom M-PESA (10 May 2023), Yaya (13 October 2023), ToloPay (3 June 2025) and Vitabirr (15 July 2025).
title: Payment Instrument Issuers/System Operators
